# zsim (PIMID-modified)

x86-64 microarchitectural timing model derived from
[zsim](https://github.com/s5z/zsim), heavily modified for PIMID. Built by
the top-level CMake as QEMU TCG plugins (`libzsim_qemu.so`,
`libpimid_trace.so`); the legacy PIN/scons build is optional. GPLv2.

Full documentation: [docs/architecture.md](../../docs/architecture.md) and
[docs/external.md](../../docs/external.md)
